about_the_game:
Blood Moon Horror

Blood Moon Horror is a terrifying 1-8 player co-op survival horror experience set on an alien-infested lunar research base. When the blood moon rises, something awakens—and begins to hunt.

You are part of a rescue team sent to Lunar Base Alpha after all contact was mysteriously lost three months ago. What you discover inside will haunt your dreams: hostile extraterrestrial entities that defy understanding, and the horrifying truth behind humanity's greatest mistake.

Team up with friends or join random players in this intense multiplayer horror game where communication means life or death. No weapons, no combat—just pure survival through stealth, strategy, and cooperation.

About the Game

The year is 2078. Lunar Base Alpha was humanity's crown jewel—a state-of-the-art research facility conducting groundbreaking experiments on the moon's unique properties. But three months ago, everything changed.

The last transmission was desperate and fragmented: "The moon... it's changing. The samples... they're alive. We can't contain—"* [TRANSMISSION ENDED]

Now you're here. The base is a tomb. The entities that roam its corridors aren't just predators—they're intelligent, adaptive, and drawn to electrical activity. They hunt in darkness, use the ventilation systems, and some reports suggest they can mimic human voices.

Your mission: survive, investigate, and escape. But the base's life support is failing, time is running out, and something is awakening under the blood moon...

Key Features

  • Co-op Survival Horror (1-8 Players) – Experience true cooperative gameplay where every decision matters. Join friends for private sessions or matchmake with other survivors. No solo heroics here—survive together or die alone.

  • Proximity Voice Chat – Communicate with nearby teammates using immersive spatial audio. Coordinate silently... or hear your partner's final screams echo through the vents when they're taken.

  • Advanced Enemy AI – Face extraterrestrial predators with sophisticated behaviors. They perceive sound, patrol routes, and adapt to your strategies. Currently featuring one terrifying hunter with multiple behavioral archetypes.

  • Electric Switch Box Puzzles – Restore power to the base through complex electrical puzzles requiring perfect coordination between switches and dials. Get it wrong, and you might alert something in the darkness.

  • Document Collection & Lore – Uncover the truth by collecting classified documents scattered throughout the base. Each paper reveals more about the experiments that created this nightmare and blurs the line between victim and perpetrator.

  • Atmospheric Horror Experience – Experience first-person immersion with dynamic sound design, adaptive lighting, and environmental storytelling that creates tension and fear.

  • Progression System – Level up through XP earned from objectives, puzzles, and survival. Track comprehensive statistics across all your horrifying adventures, from puzzles solved to distance traveled.

Character Customization

Express your survival style with customizable characters. Choose from multiple scientist variants and unlock additional skins as you progress through the lunar nightmare. Whether you prefer the classic lab coat or unlock special variants, make your mark in the darkness.

Gameplay Experience

  • Exploration Phase: Navigate the abandoned lunar base, searching for supplies and clues while the blood moon looms overhead.

  • Survival Phase: When the entities awaken, use stealth, strategy, and teamwork to evade predators that hunt by sound and movement.

  • Investigation Phase: Collect documents and solve puzzles to restore power and uncover the base's dark secrets. Every discovery brings you closer to escape—and to understanding what really happened here.

  • Escape Phase: Race against failing life support systems to complete your objectives and evacuate. One wrong move, one moment of panic, and you become another victim of the blood moon.

Development Roadmap

Blood Moon Horror is in active development with regular content updates. Here's what's currently implemented and what's coming:

  • ✅ Currently Available: 1-8 player multiplayer, proximity voice chat, electric switch box puzzles, document collection system, advanced enemy AI (1 type), progression system (XP, levels, currency), comprehensive stats tracking, Steam integration.

  • 🔨 In Active Development: Fuse box puzzles, generator puzzles, 2 additional enemy types, shop system completion, additional player customization options, graphics improvements, performance optimizations.

  • 📋 Planned Features: Leaderboard system, expanded cosmetics, new maps and locations, story expansion, achievement system, sanity system affecting gameplay perception.

Content Warnings

Blood Moon Horror contains intense psychological horror elements including claustrophobic environments, jump scares, adaptive audio cues, and themes of isolation and impending doom. The proximity voice chat feature may transmit startling sounds during tense moments. Not suitable for players sensitive to horror game conventions.

Development & Community

We're committed to expanding the horror experience with regular updates and new content. Join our community for development updates, playtesting opportunities, and discussions about survival horror.

Follow us on Steam for the latest news about upcoming features and content updates. If this lunar nightmare sounds like your kind of terror, add Blood Moon Horror to your wishlist to be notified of updates and early access to new content.

The base awaits. The entities are stirring. How long can you survive under the blood moon?
